title: Block Blast Master
description: Drag colorful block shapes onto an 8x8 board, clear full rows and columns, and chain combo clears for high scores.
controls: Drag pieces from the bottom tray onto the 8x8 grid. Complete full rows or columns to blast them clear.

zh-CN.title: 方块爆破大师
zh-CN.description: 把底部多彩方块拖进 8×8 棋盘，凑齐整行或整列即可爆破得分，连消冲刺高分。
zh-CN.controls: 按住底部方块拖到棋盘空位，排满一整行或一整列即可消除。
